definitions.explanation: The person who causes harm, commits an offense, or inflicts damage on another.

examples.japanese: {加害者|かがいしゃ}が{逮捕|たいほ}された。
{加害者|かがいしゃ}と{被害者|ひがいしゃ}の{立場|たちば}は{紙一重|かみひとえ}だ。
examples.english: The line between perpetrator and victim is thin.

examples.japanese: いじめの{加害者|かがいしゃ}にも{何|なん}らかの{背景|はいけい}があることが{多|おお}い。
examples.english: Bullying perpetrators often have some kind of background circumstances of their own.

notes:
Antonym of {被害者|ひがいしゃ} (victim). Used in legal, news, and social contexts when discussing crimes, accidents, bullying, and other harmful acts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{加害者|かがいしゃ}{側|がわ} (the perpetrator's side)
・{加害者|かがいしゃ}{意識|いしき} (awareness of being the perpetrator)
・いじめの{加害者|かがいしゃ} (the bully, bullying perpetrator)
